title: Inside the two-pager: A practitioner’s synopsis
description: In the Supreme Court, your synopsis is often your only real chance to be heard. If there is one hard lesson that 12 years in the profession has driven home, it is the line above and the uncomfortable corollary that most of us know but seldom acknowledge in our drafting. A judge in the Supreme Court, given the extreme caseload, will almost always read the impugned order. If you are lucky, the court will then look at your synopsis. Only if your synopsis has done its job will the bench wade through
